scope: Full-coverage right edge (user decision 0090): pic3 40x40 target, round Size 3, end at the first pixel with column phase >= b+1.5; top H edges start one pixel inside paint; research only

compensation.endRule: first pixel x >= centre(b+1) with column phase(x,y) >= b+1.5
compensation.verticalRule: draw row r only over columns where target(r) AND target(r+1): a stroke paints texel rows r and r+1
compensation.basis: 0089/0090: long-run right edge is LONGER iff phase(x_end)-(b+1) >= +0.31 (22/22), the 4-px wall in pic2 at +0.313 was shorter; the rule keeps every end >= +0.5

rules.controls: as pic3: 19 body sections; calib1 label rule; accepted label must equal the planned row -> DERIVED_FAMILY_CONFIRMED
rules.interior: every interior target texel centre (all 8 neighbours target) is strong paint (gray drop>80) vs blank stage-before
rules.holes: every hole texel centre at Chebyshev distance>=3 from target paint has no RGB>12 change
rules.edges: as pic3 (V from one column inside); top H edges start one pixel below the row command Y
rules.status: descriptive picture verdict PREDICTIONS_MET/NOT_MET/UNMEASURED; never changes the control verdict
